_note: Vetted MCP connectors (fold-node/research/connectors/A-mcp-catalogue.md, 2026-09-06). Tier 0 = official reference servers · 1 = single-purpose, permissive licence, keyless or static key · 2 = touches a real account (warning banner, never default). OAuth-only services are NOT here on purpose: the client has no browser flow, so listing them would be a dead end — see 'locked' for the honest alternative. argv is a code-owned template array; {ROOT}-style tokens are filled at add time, never at run time; key_env names an env var the user exports, never a secret. Tier 3 = LOGIN: needs the user's own account (free); offered with an awareness card, numbered steps, hidden token entry, and a verify call — never hidden, never automatic. 'unverified': package/flag names from documentation, not yet run by us. Tier 3 = free service that needs your own account: /mcp setup <name> makes you aware, takes a yes, walks the steps, then verifies. Vet: research/connectors/C-login-connectors.md (2026-09-06).

connectors.name: github
connectors.leaves: issues/PRs/repo content ↔ GitHub (already your data there)

install.termux: pkg install golang git; git clone https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server; cd github-mcp-server; go build -o ~/.local/bin/github-mcp-server ./cmd/github-mcp-server
install.linux: binary release from the repo, or: go build -o ~/.local/bin/github-mcp-server ./cmd/github-mcp-server

connectors.what: issues, PRs, repo search on GitHub with a PAT
connectors.warn: a PAT can write to your repos — scope it to what you need

steps: github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained → Generate
Sirf wo repos chuno jo chahiye; permissions kam se kam
Token copy karo (ghp_/github_pat_) — yahan paste (typing hidden)

fix.ENOENT: github-mcp-server binary nahi mila — install line chalao
fix.403: fine-grained token me wo repo select nahi hai (step 2)

connectors.vetted: vetted against the servers' own docs/LICENSE files 2026-09-06 (research/connectors/C-login-connectors.md); not yet run end-to-end by us

login.account: Gmail (ya koi IMAP mail) — 2-Step Verification ON chahiye
steps: Google account → Security → 2-Step Verification ON (pehle se ho to skip; app passwords iske bina dikhte hi nahi)
myaccount.google.com/apppasswords → naam 'Aasmaan' → 16-char password copy karo (ek baar dikhta hai; spaces hata do)
Yahan apna email aur wo app password do (typing hidden)
Gmail ke liye host kuch nahi bharna — server imap.gmail.com:993 / smtp.gmail.com:465 default use karta hai; doosre mail ke liye MCP_EMAIL_SERVER_IMAP_HOST / SMTP_HOST env

fix.AUTHENTICATIONFAILED: app password galat, ya 2-Step Verification off hai

connectors.name: homeassistant
connectors.leaves: device state/commands ↔ your own Home Assistant
connectors.what: lights, switches, sensors through Home Assistant's own built-in MCP Server integration (official)
connectors.warn: only if you actually run Home Assistant

steps: HA → Settings → Devices & Services → Add Integration → 'Model Context Protocol Server' → enable (chuno kaunse entities/areas dikhe)
HA me apna profile kholo → Security → 'Long-lived access tokens' → Create → naam 'Aasmaan'
Token copy karo — yahan paste (typing hidden)
HA ka host/IP bhi chahiye (jaise homeassistant.local ya 192.168.1.20; Tailscale naam bhi chalega)

verify.note: first read-only state/list tool is probed, never a service call

fix.Connection refused: HA_HOST/port galat ya HA band hai — pehle LAN/Tailscale se pahunch check karo
fix.404: purana HA: MCP integration ka path /mcp_server/sse (SSE) hai jo ye client nahi bolta — HA update karo

connectors.name: notion
connectors.leaves: the pages/databases you shared with the integration ↔ Notion

steps: Browser me notion.so/profile/integrations kholo (login rehna chahiye)
'New integration' → naam do (jaise 'Aasmaan') → workspace chuno → Submit
'Internal Integration Secret' copy karo (ntn_ se shuru) — ye tera token hai, kisi ko mat dena
Jo pages/databases AI ko dikhane hain: page kholo → ··· → Connections → apni integration add karo (sirf wahi dikhega)
Wapas yahan aa ke token paste karo (typing hidden)

fix.401: token galat ya expire — notion.so/profile/integrations se naya secret, phir /mcp setup notion
fix.403: page integration se connect nahi hai — page → ··· → Connections → integration add karo (sabse common miss)
fix.object_not_found: page integration se connect nahi hai — page → ··· → Connections → integration add karo

connectors.name: gcal
connectors.key_kind: path to your own OAuth client JSON (Google Cloud, free)
connectors.leaves: calendar events ↔ Google; the login happens in YOUR browser via the connector, this program never sees it

install.termux: pkg install nodejs termux-api (+ Termux:API app) — pehli baar browser khulega; na khule to printed localhost URL Chrome me paste karo (same device, loopback chalta hai)

connectors.what: read/create Google Calendar events with your own free OAuth app

login.account: Google account + a free Google Cloud project (no card)
steps: console.cloud.google.com → naya project (free) → 'APIs & Services' → Enable 'Google Calendar API'
'OAuth consent screen' → External → app name + apna email → Test users me apna Gmail add karo
'Credentials' → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Application type: Desktop app → Create → Download JSON
JSON file ko kahin rakho (jaise ~/.ai-gcal.json) — share mat karo
Path yahan do; pehle use pe browser khulega, Google tumse permission poochhega (connector ka flow, hamara nahi)

fix.access_blocked: consent screen → Audience/Test users me apna Gmail add karo (step 2)
fix.access_denied: consent screen me Test users me apna email add nahi hai
fix.invalid_client: JSON galat file hai — 'Desktop app' wala OAuth client download karo
fix.ENOENT: node/npx nahi mila — install line chalao
fix.EADDRINUSE: loopback port busy — browser wala step dobara chalao

locked.canva: Canva ka MCP remote hai (mcp.canva.com) aur login OAuth 2.1 + dynamic client registration se hota hai jo CLIENT ko khud bolna padta hai — is program me abhi nahi (koi token/local-bridge option nahi). Ek generic bridge (mcp-remote) mila hai, licence/safety vet pending — clear hua to catalogue me aayega. Alternative: /agent chitrakar (prompts) + /do image_generation (keyless).
locked.google photos: Ek hi community server mila (google-photos-mcp) — README 'MIT' kehta hai par repo me LICENSE file hai hi nahi → reject. Upar se Google ne 2025-03 se library-read scopes hata diye; sirf Picker API (har baar user chunta hai) bacha hai. Alternative: takeout.google.com export (free, one-time) → folder ko filesystem connector se jodo, ya /attach ek photo.
locked.whatsapp: Ek hi asli server hai (Go bridge, WhatsApp Web jaisa link). Desktop pe advanced recipe mil sakti hai, Termux pe nahi; client messaging ke liye ToS/AMFI risk. Abhi: 'whatsapp <number>: <text>' prefilled chat kholta hai, program kuch bhejta nahi.
